# v1.8.0 - Skills Index Out of the Always-On Context, Release Notes and Inherited History Separated
## Projects 27 v1.8.0: Skills Index Out of the Always-On Context, Release Notes and Inherited History Separated

The always-on context is no longer at its limit, and this repository's releases, changelog and README describe this repository.

### Key Highlights
- **`.agents/SKILLS.md`**: the per-skill table moved out of `AGENTS.md`. Always-on context from exactly 20,000 to about 18,400 tokens, with the validator printing the headroom and warning within 5% of the budget.
- **Release notes**: Projects 24's inherited notes moved to `docs/spec/history/projects24-releases/`; Projects 27's own notes written for v1.3.0 to v1.8.0.
- **Changelog and README**: inherited Projects 24 entries clearly labelled; the README lists all 66 skills and 21 rules.

### Verification
- Local checks before release: `npm run verify`, docs completeness check, release-notes check, Unicode hygiene scan, link check.
- GitHub Actions has not run for this repository yet; the owner should check Settings → Actions → General.

**Full changelog**: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gerrardgs/Projects27/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
